entities.summary: John Kinley Tener was an Irish-born American politician and Major League Baseball player and executive. He served as the 25th governor of Pennsylvania from 1911 until 1915. A Republican, he had previously served as a U.S. representative for Pennsylvania's 24th congressional district.
